notes: allow[layer] lists every layer that `layer` is permitted to reference, including itself (same-layer peer modules are always allowed). Any (source, target) pair not listed is forbidden. Edges to/from an UNKNOWN-tagged module are never evaluated. All violations report at a single severity: "violation". API, IS and ST were added in #90 per the MOD layer map: API -> API,BL,ST,LKP (an API -> CS edge is a violation); IS -> IS,LKP,ST; ST -> ST,LKP; BL also allows IS and ST; SL and CW also allow ST (shared structures), so that making ST a known layer does not turn existing edges into violations. The MOD layer map does not list an API layer (it is taken from issue #90).
